location_fine: family living room with carpet-hung walls
key_props: two electric clothes irons used as defibrillator paddles
visual_synopsis: Shot in sepia, a grey-haired old man lies dying on a divan beneath carpet-hung walls and delivers a long close-up deathbed monologue while three relatives sit stiffly on chairs opposite him, reacting. At the end the family plugs in two electric clothes irons and presses them to his bare chest like defibrillator paddles, and a uniformed police officer appears.
